description: PostgreSQL 9.x: no declarative partitioning (relispartition, relkind 'p') and no identity columns (attidentity). Kept in its own file to show that a version-specific query set can be added or patched without touching the main definition.

sql: case c.relkind when 'r' then 'table' when 'v' then 'view' when 'm' then 'materialized_view'
when 'f' then 'foreign_table' else 'other' end as type,
when c.reltuples = 0 then 0 end as row_count,
case when c.relkind in ('v', 'm') then pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, true) end as definition,
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
left join pg_class tc on tc.oid = c.reltoastrelid
left join pg_stat_all_tables s on s.relid = c.oid
select c.relname as dataset, a.attnum as ordinal, a.attname as name,
format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) as data_type, not a.attnotnull as nullable,
pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) as default_value, col_description(c.oid, a.attnum) as comment,
join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid
join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid = a.attrelid and d.adnum = a.attnum
where n.nspname = {{schema}} and c.relname in ({{datasets}}) and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
